points_of_interest.name: The Plane Tree Cafe
points_of_interest.description: Very nice coffee bar with WC

points_of_interest.name: Bike Parking
points_of_interest.description: 15 min each direction to reach the waterfalls by foot

points_of_interest.name: Swim at Vasiliki Beach
points_of_interest.description: How to get here : Once left the port, turn left and follow the main street which takes to the bay of Vlicho and from there uphill towards Vasiliki.

points_of_interest.name: Cycle strictly on the right side of the road
points_of_interest.description: Might be some traffic on the main road, cycle strictly on the right side of the road and not next to each other.

points_of_interest.name: Be extra careful when crossing the street.
points_of_interest.description: Please stop at the stop sign and ensure that the street is clear before you cross it.
